title: Stock Market Crash: Generational BUYING Opportunity
creator: Mark Roussin CPA
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions; note: captions garble some names and figures in places
summary: Mark Roussin calls the week brutal — Nasdaq down over 5% on Friday alone, S&P 500 down nearly 4%, all three indices in correction territory, the Dow and S&P 12% off highs, Nasdaq 18% off highs and near a bear market, fear-and-greed index at 10. He compares the sell-off with 2018 (S&P −14% in Q4, then +30% in 2019), 2020 (30% crash, then a 50% rally from March lows) and 2022 (a long 20% grind), arguing 2018 is the closest parallel: strong first nine months, rising rates, trade uncertainty then, war-with-Iran uncertainty now — though today's core PPI inflation of 5% gives the Fed less room to cut than in 2019. He also covers Anthropic's IPO and GraniteShares' new 2x leveraged ETFs AIL and ANS; he plans to buy ANS, the 2x inverse Anthropic ETF, after a relief rally, expecting IPOs to pull back hard in year one. He reinstated his QQQ position after being out a while and rates its top 10: AAPL HOLD, NVDA HOLD, MSFT BUY, MU BUY, AMZN strong BUY, AMD strong BUY, TSLA slight BUY, META BUY, WMT HOLD, GOOGL strong BUY. He expects a relief rally, possibly another leg lower, with the S&P in oversold RSI territory but an unfilled gap down to 6,630. Calls: QQQ BUY; AAPL HOLD (flip from CONDITIONAL_BUY); NVDA HOLD (flip from SELL); MU BUY (flip from CONDITIONAL_BUY); GOOGL BUY (flip from HOLD); ANS CONDITIONAL_BUY.
